findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "studio" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quantum_openqasm3_repair_v1 · Public sink: run_buyer_job, quantum_openqasm3_repair_v1, check_quantum_circuit, submit_quantum_job · Destructive: run_buyer_job, quantum_cross_provider_portability_v1, quantum_managed_simulator_v1.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quantum_openqasm3_repair_v1 · Public sink: run_buyer_job, quantum_openqasm3_repair_v1, check_quantum_circuit, submit_quantum_job · Destructive: run_buyer_job, quantum_cross_provider_portability_v1, quantum_managed_simulator_v1

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
